## Activity

During January 2026, Central Eye Clinic completed 202 captures. This activity represents the imaging work recorded for the reporting month. The site’s capture activity is presented alongside the image quality and grading results below to provide a concise operational summary.

The available figures indicate that capture activity continued at the site during January 2026. Staff raised no new equipment faults this month, and no additional operational issues were reported in the information provided for this report.

## Image quality

There were 4 ungradable captures. The ungradable rate was 2.0 per cent. This measure identifies the proportion of captures that could not be used for grading and is reported with the corresponding number of ungradable captures.

## Grading

A total of 66 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 2 days. This is the midpoint measure for the time between capture and completion of grading during the reporting month.

Together, these results summarise activity, image quality and grading performance at Central Eye Clinic for January 2026.
